            self.spy_sma_200.IsReady and
            self.spy_sma_50.IsReady and
            self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady
        )

                    self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma_50 and

                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)

            if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
                self.strategy_b_shares = 0

            if self.strategy_a_shares == 0:
                if (self.previous_spy_close is not None and
                    self.previous_spy_sma_200 is not None and
                    self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma_200 and
                    current_spy_close > current_spy_sma_200):
                    quantity = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) // current_spy_close)
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                        self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

            if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:

class IndependentDailyStrategies(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]:
            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](201)
        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_200 = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_50 = None

    def OnData(self, data):
        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols.values()):
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        if self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
            if aapl_close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_close

        self.spy_closes.Add(spy_close)

        if (not self.spy_closes.IsReady or
                not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady or
                self.previous_spy_close is None or
                self.previous_spy_sma_200 is None or
                self.previous_spy_sma_50 is None):
            if self.spy_closes.Count >= 200:
                self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
                self.previous_spy_sma_200 = sum(
                    self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(200)
                ) / 200.0
                self.previous_spy_sma_50 = sum(
                    self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(50)
                ) / 50.0
            return

        spy_sma_200 = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(200)) / 200.0
        spy_sma_50 = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(50)) / 50.0

        # Sells before buys.
        if (self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and
                self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma_50 and
                spy_close < spy_sma_50):
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if (self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and
                self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma_200 and
                spy_close > spy_sma_200):
            shares = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_close)
            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = shares

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                shares = int(20_000 / aapl_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = shares

        self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
        self.previous_spy_sma_200 = spy_sma_200
        self.previous_spy_sma_50 = spy_sma_50

from AlgorithmImports import *
from collections import deque
import math


class IndependentSlotsAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.tickers = ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]
        self.symbols = {
            ticker: self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol
            for ticker in self.tickers
        }

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_sma_200 = self.SMA(self.spy, 200, Resolution.Daily)
        self.spy_sma_50 = self.SMA(self.spy, 50, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi_14 = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=2)
        self.aapl_closes = deque(maxlen=4)

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        if any(
            symbol not in data.Bars or data.Bars[symbol] is None
            for symbol in self.symbols.values()
        ):
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        previous_spy_close = self.spy_closes[-1] if self.spy_closes else None
        previous_aapl_close = self.aapl_closes[-1] if self.aapl_closes else None

        self.spy_closes.append(spy_close)
        self.aapl_closes.append(aapl_close)

        if not (
            self.spy_sma_200.IsReady
            and self.spy_sma_50.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady
            and len(self.spy_closes) >= 2
            and len(self.aapl_closes) >= 4
        ):
            return

        # Sells before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0:
            spy_crosses_below_50 = (
                previous_spy_close <= self.spy_sma_50.Previous.Value
                and spy_close > 0
                and spy_close < self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value
            )
            if spy_crosses_below_50:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0:
            spy_crosses_above_200 = (
                previous_spy_close <= self.spy_sma_200.Previous.Value
                and spy_close > self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value
            )
            if spy_crosses_above_200:
                shares = math.floor(
                    (self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_close
                )
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                    self.strategy_a_shares = shares

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0:
            aapl_red_three_days = all(
                self.aapl_closes[i] < self.aapl_closes[i - 1]
                for i in range(1, 4)
            )
            if aapl_red_three_days and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                shares = math.floor(20_000 / aapl_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = shares

from AlgorithmImports import *


class IndependentTwoSlotStrategy(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily, fill_forward=False).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily, fill_forward=False).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily, fill_forward=False).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily, fill_forward=False).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily, fill_forward=False).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](201)
        self.aapl_closes = RollingWindow[float](2)

        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        # Private strategy lots
        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        # Market-state quantities are updated continuously whenever their bars exist.
        if self.spy in data.Bars:
            self.spy_closes.Add(data.Bars[self.spy].Close)

        if self.aapl in data.Bars:
            aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

            if self.aapl_closes.Count > 0:
                if aapl_close < self.aapl_closes[0]:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_closes.Add(aapl_close)

        # Skip all rule evaluation if any subscribed ticker is missing today's bar.
        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        # Sells before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and self.spy_closes.Count >= 51:
            current_sma50 = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(50)) / 50.0
            previous_sma50 = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 51)) / 50.0
            previous_spy_close = self.spy_closes[1]

            if previous_spy_close >= previous_sma50 and spy_close < current_sma50:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            if self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
                self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and self.spy_closes.Count >= 201:
            current_sma200 = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(200)) / 200.0
            previous_sma200 = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 201)) / 200.0
            previous_spy_close = self.spy_closes[1]

            if previous_spy_close <= previous_sma200 and spy_close > current_sma200:
                quantity = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_close)

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            if self.aapl_red_streak >= 3 and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                quantity = int(20_000 / aapl_close)

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

                        self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

        self._update_market_state(data)

    def _update_market_state(self, data: Slice):
        spy_symbol = self.symbols["SPY"]
        aapl_symbol = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        if spy_symbol in data.bars:
            spy_bar = data.bars[spy_symbol]
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.close
            if self.spy_sma_200.is_ready:
                self.previous_spy_sma_200 = self.spy_sma_200.current.value
            if self.spy_sma_50.is_ready:
                self.previous_spy_sma_50 = self.spy_sma_50.current.value

        if aapl_symbol in data.bars:
            aapl_bar = data.bars[aapl_symbol]
            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_bar.close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.close
